option_labels.description: Human-readable label per option_ids entry, index-aligned. Omitted or empty on events predating this field.

option_descriptions.description: Human-readable description per option_ids entry, index-aligned with option_labels. Omitted or empty on events predating this field.

expressed_confidence.description: Confidence in the decider's own words: low, medium or high (validated by the commands layer at capture). Omitted when the decider stated none; never system-computed.

quote.description: Verbatim words of the decider, self-contained. Requires question.

question.description: The question this decision answers, in the capturer's own words. Required when quote is present (a quote is unreadable without the question it answers); may stand alone. The write path also resolves it to a Question node (question.recorded + relation.added ANSWERS).

project.description: Registered project handle the decision is filed under. Omitted means no handle was given (project_source is then personal_fallback) or the event predates the field; the projector derives the recorder's personal project from actor_id, it is never stored.

project_source.description: How project was determined. Omitted on events predating this field; the write layer records personal_fallback whenever no project handle is given.
